notes.title: Kick & Ban Update
notes.notes:
Dear track building community,

we recently pushed pushed some changes around the kick/ban system but we noticed some bugs as well as occasional accidental blockings of friends. Therefore we tried to overhaul it a bit. Here is an overview:

- You can kick via [ESC]->[Manage Players]

- The host kicks instantly. Non-master players can majority vote-kick. Kicked players will be thrown out of a session.

- When kicking, you'll be asked whether you want to block the player as well. If you are host and blocked a player, the player won't be able to join any your sessions anymore (that is why you don't want to block your friends). You can unblock players in the main menu under [ESC]->[Blocked Players]. 

- Additionally, we have now the possibility to issue global blocks ("[b]bans[/b]"). Banned players will automatically be blocked from every session if the host did not un-block the player via the block list locally. That means if you're banned, you can still play with your friends online if you ask them to un-block you. However, random matchmaking will be disabled.
[strike]We want to ban players who actively try to sabotage other matches. We decide on evidence (eg replays) from Discord and we count all (locally) issued blocks as well. In any case, if you're banned, feel free to reach out to us[/strike]
UPDATE: The comments showed that the previous phrasing was very unclear. We only issue bans if we hear from many many players complains about someone actively griefing and have enough evidence to verify that. Bans are manually issued by us. They are NOT issued automatically and NOT issued pre-emptively. Bans are also not forever, we can easily unban if you reach out to us. In fact, we'd love to see everyone rehabilitated! Bans can be considered as are last resort for extreme cases to protect the community. It's a feature that has been wished many times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859694/081b4608e8a1fbe6ad7d0c90ef6f315fc9aeae5e.png[/img]

We are going to ban some players right away and hope that less players are motivated to grief in general.

Thank you for your support and happy trackbuilding! <3


Changelog:
- New: You'll be notified when you're banned
- Improvement: Kicked players no longer get added to block list automatically. Instead, a popup appears to ask whether you want to block the player as well.
- Improvement: The block list now indicates which blocks are global blocks
- Fix: Player flickering when in block list
- Fix: Lost achievement reachable in shop
- Fix: (Hopefully) Controller remapping can no longer unbind movement stick
- Fix: Invite friends option reappeared in lobby
- Fix: Crash dumper sometimes having issues
- Neat: You can add replayfps [fps] to you setting file to improve replay quality. Note that this will prevent you from uploading you replays to the highscore!

Oh and completely unrelated: Did you know that you can change the camera in the replays since our very old versions? We added a small documentation here: https://unrailed-wiki.com/page/Replay

notes.title: New Game Mode & More
notes.notes:
Heya railroad workers!

We're back with an update that includes a new game mode and a bunch of features you guys asked for here on Steam and over on our Discord server ( http://discord.gg/unrailed ). 

First of all, we are trying out a new game mode - "TIME-MODE" by name - that lets you race against the clock, and puts you against a randomized order of biomes.

Next, we've added "auto-save" feature to the checkpoint system: In your savegame list, there should now be a last visited checkpoint as first entry. The savegame won't be deleted when opening it and should hopefully reduce the amount of lost savegames. Just keep in mind that there is currently only one such slot, so if you start a new checkpoint game, the slot will be overwritten by the last checkpoint of the new game. Also note that you can still save at any station or at the last checkpoint just as before, independent of this feature.

The kick system has also been improved, now the host has the complete power over who gets kicked which prevents other players from joining and kicking the host. Otherwise, two (non-host) players can also votekick somebody out. You can kick via [ESC]->[Manage Players]. Votekicks should appear as information popup for all other players.

There is also now a statistics menu that shows you a lot of stats from the game - like how many trees you chopped and how much time you spend on mars.

And finally, we've fixed a lot of the bugs you reported on the #Bugs channel on Discord.

As always, should you have some feedback or if you find bugs we haven't fixed yet let us know here or on our Discord server.

notes.title: The Single-Player Update
notes.notes:
[b]Heya railroad workers![/b]

This update has been in the works for a loooong time. A single player mode was actually one of the first things we worked on after we bolted down the core gameplay.  We iterated through a couple of design approaches, however we never felt that the single-player mode came close enough to the chaotic gameplay that ensues when playing Unrailed cooperatively. 

But since a single-player mode has been by far the most requested feature since our launch in September, we decided to really focus on that mode and thought a lot about how to make it as interactive and chaotic as Unrailed is when played with other players. And we think this time we managed to get there.

What we came up with is the following: When you play alone, the bot will help you out! And just like with human players, you can give it commands using emoji, but the bot will actually follow them😁. You can even let it know exactly where you want to lay your tracks through and the bot helps you plough through that path.

Also, we added a sandbox-mode, where you can customize your train right at the beginning with all things you have already unlocked, to help you train with different train-setups.

We hope you'll dig the new modes as much as we do! 

And as always, should you have any feedback, leave it down here or on our [url=https://discord.gg/unrailed]Discord-server[/url].

notes.title: 2nd Early Access Update
notes.notes:
Heya railroad workers!

Alright, time for update number two. It's a smaller one but it comes with two frequently requested featuers - new languages and savegames:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859694/182e2af6680b387556b99e972786c2ffcfe3087b.png[/img]

Languages are pretty self-explanatory (and featured in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/34859694/announcements/detail/1725372378527998693]another post[/url]), but let me say a couple of words about savegames: We know they are a controversial feature because on one hand, they allow inexperienced players to progress faster, but on the other hand it might take away from the roguelike core of Unrailed.

We decided to tackle this problem in two parts:
Part one allows you save [b]and quit[/b] at each train station and continue if you return - but there is still permadeath - if you crash you have to begin from scratch.  This is just a convenience feature for people that want to split their sessions into parts.
Part two enables players to progress in the game without having to restart from the beginning if they crash. Here the first station in each new biome acts as a checkpoint. This means you'll still have to work quite a bit for each checkpoint, but allows you to learn quicker from your mistakes. However, games with checkpoints activated are not shown on the online leaderboards.

As always, if you have feedback or even already an idea how we could improve our save-system-approach come by our [url=https://discord.gg/73HFDQj]Discord server[/url].

notes.title: Community Recap #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859694/19774a16ddde3ae12c8e950d3c2de5e65e4e2bda.png[/img]

Hey, railroad workers!

It has now been precisely one week since we dived deep into Early Access territory and presented our precious indie game Unrailed! to the public. And what a week it was – the sheer amount of feedback you guys have been delivering on Discord or Steam is mindblowing. And we are already on it.

[u][b]Feedback[/b][/u]

Since most of the things you are bringing to our ears need some tinkering in the code, it's only realistic that it takes a bit longer to fully implement gameplay feedback (When it comes to hotfixing issues, you can see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1016920/announcements/detail/2978491455739418088]here[/url] the urgent fixes we did right after Early Access Launch) – but that was not everything you were talking about in the last 7 days: Aligned to your feedback we reworked a lot of our [url=https://discord.gg/YZEsWy9]Discord Server[/url]:

[b]Content Ideas[/b]
Even though we already have some great plans of our own, we still appreciate and value the big Hive Mind – so keep those brilliant thoughts coming, who knows, maybe you will find your new idea in the game sooner or later.

[b]Streams[/b]
Since Unrailed! is connected to Discord you can easily stream your gameplay via the Discord Feature – but if you are streaming on another plattform, feel free to leave us your link, so we can say hi!

[b]Competitive[/b]
Unrailed! might be a co-op spectacle where you work together to achieve your goal – but seemingly that doesn't stop you, our community, from trying to test yourself against other players as well. This is why we created a brand new "competitive-section" on our Discord Server, where you are able to share your Distance Highscores or Speedrun Records!

If you already want to test your skills: We found a particularly tricky Seed, which some players of our community declared "unbeatable" – why dont you give it a try? It is Seed [b]ZH86cCs[/b]

[b]Experimental Branch[/b]
As some of you seem to be crazy scientists in your free time, we want to give you the possiblity to test our newest inventions (balancing and/or small reworks) – before they are "save". If you dont shy away from possible crashes or bugs, feel free to reach out to "Penta der Panther" or the Developers in our [url=https://discord.gg/YZEsWy9]Discord Server[/url].


[u][b]PAX West 2019[/b][/u]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859694/52e31b487ccfd0f707b71477c4ac1343196dffdb.jpg[/img]

Our trip to Seattle right before the Early Access Launch was a great way of seeing player reactions first hand - especially since some people might say, having your teammate right next to you opens up a whole new layer of "fun". Seeing you interact with each other – and seeing that the crowd got hyped up watching you wiggle through the maps – was the most wonderful thing we could have experienced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34859694/1c75a9386fbde08adba6238d790c0a274a7f1e2a.jpg[/img]

This is it for today's Community Recap, but we have a lot of stuff in the pipelines to make this Early Access Phase an awesome experience for everyone involved – so stay on track, cause this train won't stop!

[b]We are delighted to announce that the colourful co-op railway-building game Unrailed! is out now in Steam Early Access![/b]

[previewyoutube=QXmTZkgpFio;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]Check out our early access trailer!
Unrailed! demands strategy, coordination and communication across a variety of gameplay modes because this train simply will not stop for anything! Plan ahead, cut down trees and rocks, lay down tracks to avoid hazards, upgrade your train with new wagons, and fend off any creature that gets in your way. Play with up to four players in co-op, take on Endless mode, where just one misstep can end your journey, or work as a duo to get your train to the station before your rivals in competitive multiplayer.

As an extra bonus, all players who helped test Unrailed! during closed beta will be upgraded to the full version of the game for free as thanks from us to you. Your feedback provided in closed beta was invaluable to the game’s development, and we will definitely continue to work with the community on new features, improvements, fixes and more throughout early access. 
Keep up the great support!

[u][b]Key Features:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Unstoppable train action: Procedurally generated worlds offering immense replay value.
[*] Discover loads of landscapes, inhabitants, quests and crafting elements.
[*] Endless mode: Unlimited challenges with a mix of difficulty settings and wagon upgrades.
[*] Co-op multiplayer: Play online or locally with co-op for up to four players.
